name: image-peek
description: Draws the images the agent reads (Read on png/jpg/gif/webp, image blocks in tool results) as pictures under their tool row in the terminal transcript.

maxColumns.title: Max width (columns)
maxColumns.description: Widest a preview is drawn, in terminal columns; it is also kept 6 columns inside the transcript.

maxRows.title: Max height (rows)
maxRows.description: Tallest a preview is drawn, in terminal rows.

renderer.title: Renderer
renderer.description: cells fits each cell's glyph and two colours to the picture (block elements: eighths, halves, quadrants) and works in any truecolor terminal, tmux included. half is the simple one: half blocks, two pixels a cell. image uses the kitty graphics protocol (kitty, Ghostty, outside tmux) for real pixels.

glyphs.title: Glyphs (cells renderer)
glyphs.description: blocks uses Block Elements only and works with any font. wedges adds the Powerline diagonal wedges (U+E0B8-E0BE) for smoother diagonal edges; it needs a Nerd Font, or a terminal that draws Powerline glyphs itself.

cellAspect.title: Cell aspect (height / width)
cellAspect.description: How many times taller than wide one terminal cell is, so pictures keep their shape: about 2 for Menlo, SF Mono, Cascadia and DejaVu Sans Mono, 2.2 for JetBrains Mono. A circle drawn too tall means the value is too low.

background.title: Terminal background (#rrggbb)
background.description: Your terminal's background colour, e.g. #1e1e2e. When set, picture colours within a hair of it are drawn as the terminal's own background (a screenshot of your own terminal shows no frame), and see-through edges blend over it. Empty: edges blend over dark grey; on a light theme, set it.
